messages.subject: older plyr version
parts:
Hi:
Where can I download an older version of plyr binaries. I need to use
plyr 1.1 because I am running it on a computer that has R 2.10
installed and plyr 1.4 wants R. 2.11 or higher. I will update R
eventually to the latest version but can't at the moment as I am in a
deadline to finish a project today. I checked on cran and found the
plyr_1.1.tar.gz but doesn't work after I unzip it with 7-zip. Thanks
for any pointers
